title: A £150,000 mortgage over 25 years
caption: The payment is £966.45 a month. Early on most goes to interest, so the balance falls slowly at first and fastest at the end; at year 12.5 more than half is still owed (£101,816).
alt: The mortgage balance curving down from £150,000 to zero over 25 years, flat at the start and steep at the end.
description: The monthly rate is j = 6%/12 = 0.5%, with 12 × 25 = 300 payments.
Interest takes most of early payments, so the balance falls slowly then faster.
The balance reaches zero at year 25.
